title: ASUS ROG Zephyrus Duo 16 GX651AX-SR264W Dual-Screen Gaming Laptop – Core Ultra 9 386H, RTX 5090 24GB, 64GB RAM, 2TB SSD, Dual 16″ 3K OLED Touch 120Hz, Windows 11

specs.Processor: Intel® Core™ Ultra 9 386H, 2.1GHz (up to 4.9GHz), 16 Cores / 16 Threads, 18MB Cache
specs.Display Features: 120Hz Refresh Rate, 0.2ms Response, ROG Nebula HDR, Touchscreen, Stylus Support
specs.Keyboard: RGB Backlit Chiclet Keyboard + Dedicated Copilot Key
specs.Audio Technology: Dolby Atmos, Smart Amp Technology, AI Noise Cancelation
specs.Additional I/O: 1x HDMI 2.1, 1x 3.5mm Combo Audio Jack, 1x microSD UHS-II Card Reader
specs.Special Lighting: Slash Lighting + Aura Sync (via Pogo Pin)
specs.Security: TPM, Microsoft Pluton Security, BIOS Password Protection
specs.Included Accessories: ROG Backpack, ROG Fusion II 300 Headset, ROG Gladius III Mouse
specs.Software Extras: Xbox Game Pass (3 Months), Microsoft 365 Trial
specs.The Zephyrus Duo combines two full-size:
10 OLED panels in one mobile chassis,
        giving you a true multi-display workspace wherever you go.
specs.TWO FULL-SIZE 16-INCH DISPLAYS:
The Zephyrus Duo combines two full-size 16:10 OLED panels in one mobile chassis,
        giving you a true multi-display workspace wherever you go.
Dual Screen, Laptop, Sharing, Book and Tent modes let the Zephyrus Duo adapt
        to gaming, coding, presenting, multitasking and creative workflows.
Built for demanding gaming, AI workloads, 3D rendering and professional content creation.
        The RTX 5090 Laptop GPU can run at up to 150W Max TGP, paired with the Intel Core Ultra 9 386H.
specs.POWER FOR EVERYTHING:
The Intel Core Ultra 9 386H features 16 cores and 16 threads, with an integrated
          NPU delivering up to 50 TOPS for local AI acceleration and Copilot+ PC features.
specs.64GB LPDDR5X-8533:
Ultra-fast LPDDR5X memory gives the Zephyrus Duo workstation-class multitasking capability
          for gaming, editing, large creative projects and professional applications.
specs.2TB PCIe 5.0 NVMe SSD:
High-speed PCIe 5.0 storage gives fast access to games, applications and large creative files.
          A second M.2 slot is available for expansion.
Both 16-inch OLED touch displays deliver 2880 × 1800 resolution, 120Hz refresh rate,
        0.2ms response time, rich HDR contrast and professional-grade color.
specs.KEEP THE POWER UNDER CONTROL:
A custom vapor chamber, dual fans, liquid metal and graphite nano-insulated film
        work together to manage heat inside this ultra-complex dual-screen chassis.
specs.DISTINCTLY ZEPHYRUS:
CNC-machined aluminum construction and the signature Zephyrus design language
        give the Duo a premium finish without losing its unmistakable gaming identity.
The magnetic wireless keyboard gives the Duo its flexibility:
          use it attached like a traditional laptop, move it away for a full dual-screen workspace,
          or position it wherever your setup demands.
specs.SIX-SPEAKER SOUND:
A six-speaker system with Smart Amp technology and Dolby Atmos delivers
          spacious sound for games, movies and music.
specs.90WH BATTERY:
A 90Wh battery powers the Duo on the move, while USB-C charging support
          up to 100W gives you a lighter charging option when full gaming power is not required.
specs.READY FOR A FULL DESKTOP SETUP:
High-speed Thunderbolt 4, HDMI 2.1, USB-A, UHS-II SD card reader and wireless connectivity
        make the Zephyrus Duo ready for monitors, storage, docks and professional peripherals.

ROG ZEPHYRUS DUO 2026
    

    
      DUO IT ALL
    

    
      A flagship dual-screen gaming and creator laptop built around two full-size
      16-inch 3K OLED touch displays, Intel Core Ultra performance and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 graphics.
    

    
  


  
  
    

      
        PROCESSOR
        Intel Core Ultra 9 386H
      

      
        GRAPHICS
        RTX 5090 24GB GDDR7
      

      
        MEMORY
        64GB LPDDR5X-8533
      

      
        STORAGE
        2TB PCIe 5.0 SSD
      

    
  


  
  
    
      DUAL SCREEN EXPERIENCE

      
        TWO FULL-SIZE 16-INCH DISPLAYS
      

      
        The Zephyrus Duo combines two full-size 16:10 OLED panels in one mobile chassis,
        giving you a true multi-display workspace wherever you go.
      
    

    
  


  
  
    
      FIVE OPERATING MODES

      
        ONE MACHINE. FIVE WAYS TO WORK.
      

      
        Dual Screen, Laptop, Sharing, Book and Tent modes let the Zephyrus Duo adapt
        to gaming, coding, presenting, multitasking and creative workflows.
      
    

    

    
      
        
      

      
        
      
    

    
      
    
  


  
  
    
      FLAGSHIP PERFORMANCE

      
        RTX 5090. CORE ULTRA 9.
      

      
        Built for demanding gaming, AI workloads, 3D rendering and professional content creation.
        The RTX 5090 Laptop GPU can run at up to 150W Max TGP, paired with the Intel Core Ultra 9 386H.
      
    

    
  


  
  
    

      
        INTEL CORE ULTRA

        
          POWER FOR EVERYTHING
        

        
          The Intel Core Ultra 9 386H features 16 cores and 16 threads, with an integrated
          NPU delivering up to 50 TOPS for local AI acceleration and Copilot+ PC features.
        
      

      
        
          16
          Cores

          

          50 TOPS
          NPU Performance
        
      

    
  


  
  
    

      
        
      

      
        MEMORY

        
          64GB LPDDR5X-8533
        

        
          Ultra-fast LPDDR5X memory gives the Zephyrus Duo workstation-class multitasking capability
          for gaming, editing, large creative projects and professional applications.
        
      

    
  


  
  
    

      
        STORAGE

        
          2TB PCIe 5.0 NVMe SSD
        

        
          High-speed PCIe 5.0 storage gives fast access to games, applications and large creative files.
          A second M.2 slot is available for expansion.
        

        
          The secondary SSD slot supports up to PCIe Gen 4 x4.
        
      

      
        
      

    
  


  
  
    
      DUAL ROG NEBULA HDR OLED

      
        3K. OLED. TOUCH. TWICE.
      

      
        Both 16-inch OLED touch displays deliver 2880 × 1800 resolution, 120Hz refresh rate,
        0.2ms response time, rich HDR contrast and professional-grade color.
      
    

    

    

      
        3K
        2880 × 1800
      

      
        120Hz
        Refresh Rate
      

      
        0.2ms
        Response Time
      

      
        100%
        DCI-P3
      

    
  


  
  
    

      
        BUILT FOR GAMING. ACCURATE ENOUGH FOR CREATION.
      

      
        Up to 1100 nits panel peak brightness, VESA DisplayHDR True Black 1000,
        100% DCI-P3 coverage and Delta E < 1 color accuracy make the displays equally
        suited to HDR gaming and professional creative work.
      

      

        OLED
        Dolby Vision
        G-SYNC
        HDR True Black 1000
        Pantone Validated

      

    
  


  
  
    
      ROG INTELLIGENT COOLING

      
        KEEP THE POWER UNDER CONTROL
      

      
        A custom vapor chamber, dual fans, liquid metal and graphite nano-insulated film
        work together to manage heat inside this ultra-complex dual-screen chassis.
      
    
  


  
  
    
      CNC ALUMINUM DESIGN

      
        DISTINCTLY ZEPHYRUS
      

      
        CNC-machined aluminum construction and the signature Zephyrus design language
        give the Duo a premium finish without losing its unmistakable gaming identity.
      
    

    

    
  


  
  
    

      
        
          DETACH. REPOSITION. KEEP WORKING.
        

        
          The magnetic wireless keyboard gives the Duo its flexibility:
          use it attached like a traditional laptop, move it away for a full dual-screen workspace,
          or position it wherever your setup demands.
        
      

      
        Magnetic Wireless Keyboard
        
          1.7mm key travel
          Larger touchpad
          1-zone RGB lighting
        
      

    
  


  
  
    

      
        
      

      
        AUDIO

        
          SIX-SPEAKER SOUND
        

        
          A six-speaker system with Smart Amp technology and Dolby Atmos delivers
          spacious sound for games, movies and music.
        
      

    
  


  
  
    

      
        MOBILITY

        
          90WH BATTERY
        

        
          A 90Wh battery powers the Duo on the move, while USB-C charging support
          up to 100W gives you a lighter charging option when full gaming power is not required.
        
      

      
        
      

    
  


  
  
    
      CONNECTIVITY

      
        READY FOR A FULL DESKTOP SETUP
      

      
        High-speed Thunderbolt 4, HDMI 2.1, USB-A, UHS-II SD card reader and wireless connectivity
        make the Zephyrus Duo ready for monitors, storage, docks and professional peripherals.
      

      
        2× Thunderbolt 4
        HDMI 2.1 FRL
        2× USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A
        UHS-II SD Reader
        3.5mm Audio
        Wi-Fi 7
      
    
  


  
  
    
      ROG ZEPHYRUS DUO

      
        BUILT FROM EVERY ANGLE
      
    

    
  


  
  
    AVAILABLE AT COMPUMARTS

    
      A FLAGSHIP BUILT FOR PEOPLE WHO WANT MORE THAN ONE SCREEN.
    

    
      ASUS ROG Zephyrus Duo GX651AX-SR264W combines flagship gaming hardware,
      professional OLED displays and true dual-screen versatility in one premium machine.
